description_en: Queries the list of cameras associated with an intelligent alert event recording plan
description_zh: 调用该接口，查询智能告警事件录像计划，关联的摄像头列表
name: QueryEventRecordPlanDeviceByPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent alert event recording plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107907.html to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 智能告警事件录像计划ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107907.html查询
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示，默认值1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
